import zipfile
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

NS = "{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/spreadsheetml/2006/main}"

z = zipfile.ZipFile("budget.xlsx")
sroot = ET.fromstring(z.read("xl/worksheets/sheet1.xml"))

cells = {}
for c in sroot.iter(NS + "c"):
    v = c.find(NS + "v")
    if v is not None:
        cells[c.get("r")] = v.text

expense_items = [
    ("Housing", "Rent/Mortgage", "C11"),
    ("Housing", "Utilities", "C12"),
    ("Housing", "Insurance", "C13"),
    ("Transportation", "Car Payment", "C14"),
    ("Transportation", "Gas", "C15"),
    ("Transportation", "Insurance", "C16"),
    ("Food", "Groceries", "C17"),
    ("Food", "Dining Out", "C18"),
    ("Entertainment", "Streaming", "C19"),
    ("Entertainment", "Hobbies", "C20"),
    ("Savings", "Emergency Fund", "C21"),
    ("Savings", "Retirement", "C22"),
]

total = 0.0
for cat, sub, ref in expense_items:
    amt = float(cells[ref])
    total += amt
    print(f"{cat:<15} {sub:<16} {ref}: {amt:,.2f}")

print(f"\nTOTAL EXPENSES (C11:C22): {total:,.2f}")
